# Animate grid Progress column updates and clarify Home 48-line labels

## Context

Operator review of the live Portal Home front door (`#/home`) ahead of the Engine 14 cut (`2026-11-23`) surfaced two high-visibility UX/demo issues across the two `LivePreview` stages (`Portal.view.home.parts.Planning` and `Portal.view.home.parts.Grid`) and `Neo.grid.column.Progress`:

1. Both `Planning.mjs` (`'One Store · 48 Lines'`) and `Grid.mjs` (`'Live Data · 48 Lines'`) state `'48 Lines'` while `FeatureSection#activate` switches the `LivePreview` from `Source` to `Preview` after `1s`. Beside a `300 rows · ~190 updates/s` grid footer and an 11-bar Gantt/Kanban view, `'48 Lines'` reads as a broken row count rather than `48` lines of JavaScript source code in the hidden `Source` tab.
2. In the Home `Data Grid` demo, the `Demand` column (`{type: 'progress', dataField: 'demand', text: 'Demand', width: 180}`) remains completely static while `Price`, `Change`, and `Trend` tick, leaves an unused ~250 px empty right gutter on desktop viewports (`860 px` fixed column sum), and `Neo.grid.column.Progress` has no scroll/recycle-safe transition when a record's progress value updates in place.

## The Problem

1. **Ambiguous `'48 Lines'` sub-headlines left over from `#21351` / `#21365`:** When `#21365` dropped its side-by-side code-beside-preview layout (`814692033c`) and restored tabbed `Source | Preview` views, both sub-headlines kept `'48 Lines'` (`test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/home/ContentBox.spec.mjs:141-142`), hiding the referent (`Source` LOC) behind an inactive tab.
2. **Static `Demand` values & un-animated `Neo.grid.column.Progress` updates:**
   - `apps/portal/view/home/parts/Grid.mjs:68-71` seeds `demand` once at creation (`L65`) and omits `demand` from `tick(record)`.
   - `resources/css/src/grid/column/Progress.css` applies neither `flex: 1` / `width: 100%` (leaving `<progress>` pinned at its ~160 px UA intrinsic width inside `flex` or narrow columns) nor a width transition on `::-webkit-progress-value` / `::-moz-progress-bar`.
   - Per `learn/guides/datahandling/PooledGridAnimation.md`, an unconditional CSS `transition: width` on pooled grid cells would falsely animate row-pool recycling during scroll, sort, or filter when a physical cell component switches from one logical record to another.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` explicit operator front-door direction on `2026-11-23` (*"sub-titles could get changed to 48 lines of code ... and an ANIMATED progress grid column => BIG win. this is our front door after all"*) and `learn/guides/datahandling/PooledGridAnimation.md` (*"row transitions must not assume that logical records own stable DOM rows"*).
- **Record-identity check in `Neo.grid.column.Component` (`src/grid/column/Component.mjs:104-160`):** `cellRenderer(data)` already compares `component[recordProperty] === record` before writing `component[recordProperty] = record`. Forwarding `data` as the third argument to `me.applyRecordConfigs(componentConfig, record, data)` (`L126`) lets `Neo.grid.column.Progress` distinguish **in-place same-record mutations** (`component && component[this.recordProperty] === record`) from **initial cell creation** and **row-pool recycling** (`component[this.recordProperty] !== record`).
- **`Neo.component.Progress` VDOM root (`src/component/Progress.mjs:42-46,116-127`):** `getVdomRoot()` returns `this.vdom.cn[1]` (`{tag: 'progress'}`), so `cls` entries on the `Progress` component mount directly onto `<progress class="neo-progress ...">`.
- **Blink/Gecko `<progress>` transition behavior:** Empirically verified in Chromium that adding `.neo-progress-animate` and mutating `progress.value` in the same frame smoothly transitions `::-webkit-progress-value` `width`, whereas removing `.neo-progress-animate` in the same frame as a recycled record's `progress.value` snaps immediately in `0 ms` without cross-record wobble.

## The Fix

1. **Same-record animated `Neo.grid.column.Progress` (`src/grid/column/Component.mjs`, `src/grid/column/Progress.mjs`, `resources/css/src/grid/column/Progress.css`):**
   - Pass `data` to `me.applyRecordConfigs(componentConfig, record, data)` in `Neo.grid.column.Component#cellRenderer`.
   - Add `useTransition: true` config to `Neo.grid.column.Progress` and toggle `'neo-progress-animate'` in `applyRecordConfigs(config, record, data)` exclusively when `useTransition` is truthy and `data?.component?.[this.recordProperty] === record`.
   - In `resources/css/src/grid/column/Progress.css`, add `flex: 1; min-width: 0;` on `.neo-progress-wrapper` and `width: 100%;` on `progress[value]` so progress bars fill `flex` and fixed-width grid cells cleanly, and add `transition: width 220ms ease-out` on `::-webkit-progress-value` and `::-moz-progress-bar` scoped to `.neo-grid-body:not(.neo-is-scrolling) .neo-grid-cell .neo-progress-wrapper progress[value].neo-progress-animate` (with `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transition: none; }`).
2. **Portal Home `Planning` & `Grid` front-door updates (`apps/portal/view/home/parts/Planning.mjs`, `apps/portal/view/home/parts/Grid.mjs`):**
   - Change `Planning#subHeadline` to `'One Store · 48 Lines of Code'` and `Grid#subHeadline` to `'Live Data · 48 Lines of Code'` (verifying clean desktop & `390×844` typography in `FeatureSection.css`).
   - Update `Grid#livePreviewCode` (keeping exact `48` lines and `<= 91` chars/line) so `tick(record)` walks `demand` (`[8, 98]`) on every batch alongside `price`, `trend`, and `change`, and set `flex: 1, minWidth: 180` on the `Demand` column so the grid fills the desktop preview width without a dead right gutter; update `Grid#paragraph` and `@summary` to mention animated demand bars.
3. **Unit & E2E coverage (`ContentBox.spec.mjs`, `HomeComponentPreviews.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/Progress.spec.mjs`):**
   - Update `ContentBox.spec.mjs` for `'... · 48 Lines of Code'` and `demand` in `tick(record)`.
   - Add unit spec `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/Progress.spec.mjs` verifying `'neo-progress-animate'` is absent on initial render, added on same-record updates, omitted on pooled record reassignment, and suppressed when `useTransition: false`.
   - Extend `HomeComponentPreviews.spec.mjs` to assert `Demand` `<progress>` values change live under the feed and carry `.neo-progress-animate` with zero right-edge gap on desktop.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — implements `learn/guides/datahandling/PooledGridAnimation.md`'s record-identity animation contract on `Neo.grid.column.Progress` and clarifies front-door Home copy under `#20682`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Portal.view.home.parts.Planning` and `Portal.view.home.parts.Grid` render `'One Store · 48 Lines of Code'` and `'Live Data · 48 Lines of Code'`, with both `livePreviewCode` snippets remaining `<= 48` lines and `<= 91` chars/line.
- [ ] `Neo.grid.column.Progress` (`useTransition: true` by default) applies `'neo-progress-animate'` and smooth width transitions on in-place same-record updates while snapping without animation on initial mount, pooled row recycling (`scroll`, `sort`, `filter`), `useTransition: false`, `.neo-is-scrolling`, and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, and stretches `<progress>` to fill `flex` and fixed-width grid cells.
- [ ] In the Home `Data Grid` preview, `tick(record)` updates `demand` alongside `price`, `trend`, and `change`, and the `Demand` column (`flex: 1, minWidth: 180`) fills the desktop preview pane cleanly.
- [ ] Unit (`ContentBox.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/Progress.spec.mjs`) and E2E (`HomeComponentPreviews.spec.mjs`) suites pass with `0` console/page errors, and the PR embeds `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` before/after frames.

## Out of Scope

- Animating standalone non-grid `Neo.component.Progress` instances outside `Neo.grid.column.Progress`.
- Changing the `Gantt & Task Board` `livePreviewCode` logic or `Portal.view.home.parts.{Features,AiToolchain}` cards (`#22063`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Unconditional `transition: width` on `.neo-grid-cell progress[value]`:** Violates `PooledGridAnimation.md` — sorting or filtering while stationary (`!neo-is-scrolling`) recycles pooled cell components onto different records and would animate unrelated rows' values into each other.
- **Targeting `.neo-progress-wrapper.neo-progress-animate` instead of `progress.neo-progress-animate`:** `Neo.component.Progress#getVdomRoot()` returns `this.vdom.cn[1]` (`<progress>`), so component `cls` mutations land directly on `<progress>`.
- **Leaving `<progress>` at UA intrinsic width (`~160 px`):** Without `flex: 1; min-width: 0;` on `.neo-progress-wrapper` and `width: 100%` on `progress[value]`, `flex: 1` columns leave empty trailing cell space while `150 px` columns overflow.
